verdict.rationale: jo's docs describe AI-generated briefings built from connected data: GitHub PRs, open Linear issues assigned to you, "what did I miss in #engineering?" catch-up summaries, and scheduled morning priorities and weekly plans it prepares overnight. That is the core of in-product insights and suggestions from the user's own data. Missing for 10: the briefings and their recommendations are described only in short marketing and llms.txt snippets with no in-depth documentation, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit proactive suggestions beyond summaries and priorities are not evidenced.
